name: 焦虑自评量表
instructions: 请根据您最近一周的实际情况，选择最符合的一项。
instructionsEn: Based on your actual situation over the past week, choose the option that fits you best.
license: Zung 编制，可免费使用，使用时请注明出处。

options.label: 没有或很少时间
options.labelEn: None or a little of the time

options.label: 绝大部分或全部时间
options.labelEn: Most or all of the time

items.text: 我觉得比平常容易紧张和着急
items.textEn: I feel more nervous and anxious than usual.

items.text: 我无缘无故地感到害怕
items.textEn: I feel afraid for no reason.

items.text: 我容易心里烦乱或觉得惊恐
items.textEn: I get upset easily or feel panicky.

items.text: 我觉得我可能将要发疯
items.textEn: I feel that I might be going crazy.

items.text: 我觉得一切都很好，也不会发生什么不幸
items.textEn: I feel that everything is all right and nothing bad will happen.

items.text: 我手脚发抖打颤
items.textEn: My arms and legs shake and tremble.

items.text: 我因为头痛、颈痛和背痛而苦恼
items.textEn: I am bothered by headaches, neck pain, and back pain.

items.text: 我感觉容易衰弱和疲乏
items.textEn: I feel weak and get tired easily.

items.text: 我觉得心平气和，并且容易安静坐着
items.textEn: I feel calm and can sit quietly with ease.

items.text: 我觉得心跳得很快
items.textEn: I feel that my heart is beating fast.

items.text: 我因为一阵阵头晕而苦恼
items.textEn: I am bothered by spells of dizziness.

items.text: 我有晕倒发作，或觉得要晕倒似的
items.textEn: I have spells of fainting, or feel like I am going to faint.

items.text: 我呼气吸气都感到很容易
items.textEn: I can breathe in and out easily.

items.text: 我手脚麻木和刺痛
items.textEn: I feel numbness and tingling in my hands and feet.

items.text: 我因为胃痛和消化不良而苦恼
items.textEn: I am bothered by stomach pain and indigestion.

items.text: 我常常要小便
items.textEn: I have to empty my bladder often.

items.text: 我的手常常是干燥温暖的
items.textEn: My hands are usually dry and warm.

items.text: 我脸红发热
items.textEn: My face gets hot and flushed.

items.text: 我容易入睡并且一夜睡得很好
items.textEn: I fall asleep easily and sleep soundly through the night.

items.text: 我做恶梦
items.textEn: I have nightmares.

totalBands.description: 标准分低于50分，未提示明显焦虑症状。
标准分50-59分，提示轻度焦虑。
标准分60-69分，提示中度焦虑。
标准分70分及以上，提示重度焦虑。
